Name: Partner Overhaul
Author: Jared
Description: Fixes a batch of bugs in the base game's Partner companions. Partners can now eat Night Broth and Stew when starving, clean finished homes, stop over-watering full garden plots, feed Charcoal into a Fireplace or Fire Pit, butcher a Boar Piglet, smith two more blade blanks, eat Wheat Bloodbread, and clean the Mud Hut's Right Room. They keep their River and Pond duty marks through the seasonal swaps. Partner action sounds are no longer heard from another environment, and Partner dialog no longer interrupts a ritual. Also removes a stray 'Defecate' button from the Tree Top event, shows a Partner's Energy and Comfort on its card, and stops a powder such as Acorn Flour from being destroyed when poured into a container that cannot hold it all. Opt-in options (default off): Partners tending and warming themselves at a Hearth, cheaper Partner moves (some hops cost nothing), a reserved fuel list, drinking from lakes and streams (not yet seen working in a game), a cold Partner asking for warmth sooner, merged duplicate wounds (easier combat), and diagnostics for bug reports.
